services.name: Field trips
services.desc: Discover the captivating world of illusions, perception, and optical phenomena at the Museum of Illusions! Our field trips provide an engaging and educational adventure for students in grades K-12, set in a unique and mind-bending environment. Our museum is a STEM.org accredited Educational Experience, and was voted “Top 5% Best in STEM”. Our immersive exhibits, paired with turnkey lesson plans we’ve created with STEM.org, allow your students to explore the museum through the perspectives of science, technology, art, history, and mathematics, while providing educators with a diverse range of concepts, activities, and subjects to explore before, during, and after their visit to our museums.
